title: doftiles
description: Personal dotfiles: GNU Stow packages, Makefile deployment with hooks, herbstluftwm on WSL2.

content.heading: doftiles
content: dots - herbstluftwm on WSL2, deployed with GNU Stow and Make.

content.heading: From the README
content: Every top-level directory is a stow package whose contents mirror `$HOME`; recipes link them with `stow -R -t $HOME <package>`. Deploy through make, never bare stow.

```sh
cd ~/dots
git submodule update --init --recursive   # polywins + opencode-screencast
make install                              # full WM host
make bash                                 # headless / container
```
WSL2 needs VcXsrv on the Windows side; convention is `DISPLAY=localhost:0.0`.

content.heading: Packages provided
Shell and tooling
content: shell - `.bashrcx`, `.profile`, aliases, exports; firefox -> Windows Firefox; `check-wsl`
llms - OpenCode + poolside config, SonarQube/MCP tooling

content.heading: Window manager stack
content: compton - compositor config, rofi context-menu helpers
Caveat: `wm.packages` is stale - pre-rename `opencode`, omits `vim`/`zshell`/`maintenance`; stow those individually.

content.heading: Deployment via Make
content: Each recipe's effect includes its prerequisite recipes (run first, in listed order).
